contexts.text: Like things are represented by the waters of the Sea Suph, as are signified by the waters of the Flood. Explained.
The profanation of good through faith separated, is represented by the Egyptians being immersed in the Red Sea.
The destruction (of the vastated Church) was represented by the submersion of the Egyptians in the Sea Suph.
The removal of such Spirits, and their being thrust down into Hell, is represented by the destruction of Pharaoh and the Egyptians in the Sea Suph. AC 7039:end. AC 7844:2.
For the Sea Suph = Hell. AC 8125. AC 8200. AC 8265. AC 8275. TCR 635:2.
It cast (the locusts) into the Sea Suph () = into Hell. Explained.
Transmission through the midst of damnation, is signified by the passing through the Sea Suph.

That the Sea Suph = the damnation which they were first to pass through, is evident from the signification of the Sea Suph, which is, the Hell where are those who are in faith separated from charity, and in a life of evil; and, as the Sea Suph = Hell, it also = damnation.

The Hell signified by the Sea Suph is in front deep under the Hells of adulterers, and it extends considerably towards the left. It is separated from (these) Hells by waters like those of the sea... Those who are being delivered from infestations are... led towards the left, through the midst of (this) Hell, and come out at the left, where there is as it were a desert... While they are passing through, they are so protected by the Lord that not the least of evil... can reach them; for they are encompassed with a column of Angels, with whom the Lord is present. This was represented by the passing of the sons of Israel through the Sea Suph. Illustrated.
The Sea Suph = the Hell where are falsities from evils.

When man is being tempted, he is especially near this Hell which is signified by the Sea Suph; for there are those who have been in the knowledge of truth, but in a life of evil, and are thence in falsities from evil... Hence may be evident what is meant by the influx of temptation from Hell, signified by ye shall encamp... near the Sea Suph ().

They overtook them encamping near the Sea () = communication around the region of Hell where are falsities from evils; (for) the Sea, here, the Sea Suph, = the Hell where are the falsities from evil of those who have been in faith separated from charity, and in a life of evil. AC 8159.
The Sea Suph = the Hell in which are the falsities from evil of those who have been of the Church.
To divide the Sea () = the dissipation of the falsities of the Hell represented by the Sea Suph.
The Sea (Suph) here, = falsity.
Were submerged in the Sea Suph () = that they enclosed themselves with falsities from evil. Explained.
Moses made Israel journey from the Sea Suph () = what is successive according to the order of Divine truth, after they had passed through the region of Hell. Explained.

I will set thy border from the Sea Suph... () = extension from scientific truths... For the Sea Suph = truths sensuous and scientific, which are the last (or ultimate) ones with man; for the Sea Suph was the ultimate border of the land of Egypt. AE 518:17.
Therefore the locusts were cast into the Sea Suph, by which is signified Hell.
The birds and spectres cast themselves into a sea, which is there called the Sea Suph.
I felt as it were waters around me: this is the Hell represented by the Sea Suph.
Hence it is evident what is signified by the east wind which dried up the Red Sea, by which is signified Hell.
The Sea Suph () = damnation.
The dispersion of evils is signified by the passage through the Sea Suph, of which it is said that it fled ().
For by the immersion of Pharaoh and the Egyptians in the Sea Suph was represented the Last Judgment, and damnation.

To the shore of the Sea Suph in the land of Edoni () = the knowledges of the natural man... For the Sea Suph... was the ultimate boundary of the Land of Canaan, by (which) are signified the ultimates of the Church, which are knowledges which comprehend the Knowledges of truth and good.
By the Sea Suph is signified the Hell where are falsities from evil.
The like is here meant as by the drying up of the Sea Suph...
The final destruction (of the natural man separated from the spiritual) is described by the submerging of Pharaoh and all his army in the Sea Suph.
To possess the Land, from the Sea Suph to the river Euphrates () = the Church with all its extension, which is from the Lord with those who are conjoined with Him through Divine truth.
